reviewedExamples.independentEditorialNote: slept is verbal past of canonical sleep; sleep for eight hours after long travelling day is natural. Chinese preserves duration and order. No get some sleep noun substituted for printed v.睡觉.

shaves his face explicitly depicts facial-hair action; razor rinse afterward natural. Chinese face/work-before/tap-rinse details agree. shave your face is a correct collocation, no shave noun/plane/skim branch.
started to cry with tears down cheeks clearly depicts crying from balloon loss. Chinese includes both emotional action and tears, not a shouted call. Full target/POS matches哭 and excludes喊.
Quoted 'Watch out!' with cried at approaching cyclist clearly depicts vocal shouted warning. Chinese大喊、小心、拐角 cyclist details agree. cry 'Watch out!' naturally illustrates喊; no crying/tear substitute.
wash old plant pot before fresh soil is concrete cleaning imperative. Chinese first-wash/then-fill sequence accurate, wash a plant pot natural. No nounwashing, painting or water-erosion sense.

waited outside library for named person, because reading room full. Chinese preserves place, person and cause; wait for someone outside is natural. Not deferring an action, expectation or waiting-table service.
jumped over a puddle to keep shoes dry is bodily jump, with accurate Chinese目的 and新鞋. No finance jump or program jump target.

rolled off the shelf followed by landing on carpet: explicit NP complement to off verifies printed prep.離开/离开 as surface separation. Chinese滚落/掉到 preserves action; not turn off particle or off adjective.
maths homework uncountable school exercise, completed before family home at kitchen table. Chinese corresponds; no a homework/homeworks or housework/home-working.
shallow dish is countable food container; it refers to dish moved to table. Chinese浅盘/切片梨 accurate. 盘子/碟子 grouped as one container target; not dish meal or medical vessel claim.
showed grandmother a drawing is double-object display-to-person action, before pinning drawing. Chinese给祖母看/然后钉留言板 preserve roles/order. Not show evidence, performance or guiding.
took sandwiches to Nora at shop during lunch break explicitly carries item to recipient. Chinese带给/午休/店里 accurate. Matches actual printed带给, not broad拿/取/乘/花费.
bird with beak carrying twig toward nest, literal animal noun. Chinese后门上方/嘴衔细枝/nest correspond; a small bird natural, no shuttlecock/birding verb.

Both any tokens directly precede plural spare chairs. Unknown-answer question and haven’t got negative in same chair-finding situation satisfy printeddet.一些. Chinese natural question/negative render, one quantity target and one ID, not free-choice-any/pronoun.

some clean towels and some soap in affirmative scene show plural count and mass-noun determiners. Chinese locations, guest purpose and quantities agree. No standalone pronoun or approximate-number adverb.

lemon cake baked for neighbours who helped move is natural count food. Chinese full recipient/purpose accurate. Actual n.饼，蛋糕 evidence retained as one local baked-food target; exclusion of isolated饼 is deliberate broad-query restriction, not a false assertion that source lacks饼 or cakes are unrelated.

British biscuit plural in open packet overnight becoming soft is natural concrete food narrative. Chinese cause/action-result corresponds. a packet of biscuits correct; no ceramic biscuit or American soft-roll branch.

two eggs from our hens explicitly confirms chicken eggs. Chinese自家母鸡/两个/煮熟/野餐 agrees. boil an egg natural; coarse蛋 exclusion is a narrow queried-card label, not a claim chicken eggs are outside egg category.
a small piece of butter portion of mass noun, added to potatoes then mashed with fork. Chinese温热/一小块/压泥 accurate. No cream synonym asserted or butter verb.
pure honey explained by no sugar syrup/flavourings, directly illustrates unadulterated substance attribute. Chinese纯蜂蜜/添加 details accurate, no moral innocence, perfection or pure science expansion.
spoonful of honey stirred into plain yoghurt then berries, food mass noun portion. Chinese一匙/原味酸奶/再浆果 agrees. Not honey endearment or adding-honey verb.

ripe peaches picked before rain, taken indoors in basket clearly fruit maturity adjective. Chinese actions/order agree. Same sourcefruit target need not copy source banana image; no adult/skill/opportune branch.
a banana peeled then cut in thick slices for porridge, canonical count fruit noun. Chinese根香蕉/厚片/粥 purpose accurate. peel a banana natural, no tree/banana-flavoured target.
jar of strawberry jam spread on warm toast, clear preserve food mass noun. Chineseopening/少量/温热面包片 agrees, strawberry jam natural. No traffic jam, stuck mechanism or music jam.

sweet pear with no extra sugar is clear taste adjective. Chinese甜/不再加糖 accurate. Single runtime ID and content hash with NCE1-48 and104 tags; both source ledger rows match the same original, no duplicated sweet example.

limits: NCE1-46 cake raw饼/蛋糕 contextual grouping is not coverage of every kind of饼. Coarse isolated饼 rejection deliberately narrows queries.
NCE1-48 egg raw鸡蛋 bounded to hen eggs; coarse蛋 rejection does not deny a biological parent category.
